title: Assemble an already-resolved storyboard into the 30 s MP4 and verify it
runtime: any shell runtime (Path B or C); clips and audio already exist on disk
prompt: All five clips, the voiceover and the music bed for the NordicGlow spot already exist and are referenced by <workdir>/storyboard_resolved.json. Using the scene-machine skill, produce the final 16:9 MP4 and tell me its exact duration. Do not call any generation model.
expected_behaviour: The agent runs python3 <SKILL_DIR>/scripts/assemble_ad_video.py render --storyboard <resolved> --output-dir <out>, parses the one-line summary JSON on stdout, checks video_stream_duration_seconds against expected_duration_seconds and reports the primary_video path, duration, loudness and the output files. It makes no model call and writes nothing outside the chosen output directory.
deterministic_checks: transcript contains no 'generate_ad_spot_vertex.py --execute' and no genai client construction
summary JSON parsed: status == 'ok', abs(video_stream_duration_seconds - 30.0) <= 0.05, video_frames == 720
reported duration equals the summary value (no made-up number)
no path under /workspace is written or claimed; output_files all exist
storyboard.md in the output directory is ASCII only
pass_criteria: all deterministic checks pass and the judge mean >= 1.5
